steps.observable_result: Post reads spec.md, phases/index.md and every referenced physical phases/P<n>.md before selecting the next Phase task from current facts; pre/history retain plan.md and tasks.md through the cohort-specific reader.
RED evidence demonstrates the intended behavioral change, or current task facts records why RED is not applicable.
The scoped implementation exists in the task worktree and the actual changed files are recorded in current task facts.
Every behavior Phase is classified against its actual changed files; an unchanged route is recorded as such and a changed route includes its reason.
The current WorkflowHub session directly uses the selected backend/frontend/fullstack testing package, or records why testing is not applicable for a material-only task.

The concrete testing strategy runs against the real worktree. Declared command/service acceptance scenarios execute through the official handler and private runner, recording per-AC actual/oracle, actor, exit/cancel/cleanup and raw evidence; missing or failed items remain visible instead of inferring acceptance from exit 0.
The current diff is checked for scope and behavior, and the actual findings are recorded in current task facts.

Dispatch one OCR delegation review through review --action=record with review_scope=phase, subject_kind=phase, and the current phase_id. Consume its canonical result or unavailable attempt through run receipts.review. The phase_review fact remains visible; unavailable limits quality claims and permits same-task repair.
Every review finding has a disposition in current task facts; valid findings are repaired before handoff.
The actual implementation and execution facts are current in the task worktree and current task facts; no parallel implementation record is created.
current task facts is marked completed only when actual changes, tests, AC evidence, and review dispositions support that claim; missing quality facts stay incomplete but do not block repair.
After all implementation tasks, the recorded final aggregate command runs once and its real exit, coverage limits, and per-AC trace are recorded; this does not claim provider review or pass.

The existing spec-analyze profile checks the original requirement and current cohort materials against implementation, tests, AC trace, Phase review facts, and user-result evidence; valid gaps are repaired in this stage and a plain-language six-field summary is produced before handoff.

The current WorkflowHub session gives a plain-language handoff covering what changed, how it works, final tests and AC trace, Phase-review findings, remaining risks, and verify-code's one final worktree review; the comment is notification, not a gate.
当前主会话直接执行阶段末复盘；复盘是非阻断的过程判断，按当前 task facts 和正式质量原件记录，未使用外部 Stage Agent outcome。
